source.title: Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings 2025 (provisional), resident analysis (ASHE table 8, place of residence by local authority), via Nomis dataset NM_30_1
source.table: NM_30_1: sex 8 full-time workers, item 2 median, pay 7 annual pay gross (pay 1 weekly read beside it)

rows.measure: median gross annual pay of full-time employees by place of residence, over 12
rows.note: the publisher's median gross annual pay, GBP 46,414 a year, over 12 (rounded to the pound); employees who live in London, wherever they work (ASHE table 8, the place of residence analysis); annual pay counts employees in the same job for at least a year; the weekly median is GBP 902.7 (not used); measured for the London region (Greater London); 2025 figures are provisional; coefficient of variation 1.2%
